title: Out of memory: the AI service is stopped first, Klipper and Moonraker are protected
note: Insurance only: it does not lower memory use. The kernel kills by 'badness + OOMScoreAdjust'. algo_app gets +500 (it restarts itself after 15 s), Klipper and Moonraker get -300. Before: all three were 0 (checked on the printer 22.11). Takes effect when the services restart (the installer does that). Remove by uninstalling the module.
